subject: general
question: Which of the following Dynasties established the kingdom of Vijayanagara?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sangama Dynasty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vijayanagara was founded in 1336** by Harihara and Bukka of the Sangama dynasty**. On the south bank of the Tungabhadra river,__ they founded a new city named Vijayanagara.
